training_description: Three matched 3K continuations: cached original data; 50% new original-policy data; 50% new student-policy data. Both collection drivers use identical disjoint initial states. Same selected Condition model, frozen b/Generation, optimizer, age distribution, batch2, first-five action L1. No extra inference computation.
student_condition_description: Selected observation-dependent K8 model, unchanged architecture; original anchor and current observations only.
